quadratic.reason: Roots are (1+sqrt(5))/2 and (1-sqrt(5))/2; only the first has absolute value above one.

cubic.reason: No rational root; discriminant -23 gives one real root rho>1. The other two roots are conjugate with squared modulus 1/rho<1, so Mahler measure equals rho.

conclusion: The cubic measure is rigorously below 7/5. Any attempted universal lower bound of 1.4 is incompatible with this known example.
limit: Two explicit examples only; no enumeration minimum or degree-independent lower bound.
